_doc: Uphill houses with their garage dug into the slope (the scenic Sao Paulo's hills, map sao_paulo, seed 1; the lots tests/core/lot_site_test.gd lists): a row of three lots rising from the street to the west, each garage door at the street's level and the house above. setView: [x, y, zoom, azimuth, elevation], y the map's north (our -z); the azimuth puts the camera at +x at 0 and +z at 90.
